summary: Searches a null-terminated table of string pointers rooted at dword_8D3E90 for an entry whose first cchCount1 bytes match lpString1 under the case-insensitive collation MbsnbicollCRTStringCollation, requiring the string to terminate (next byte is '=' 61 or null) immediately after the matched prefix. Returns the entry index on match; returns a negated index when the table is exhausted or empty.

operations.description: Point v2 at the table base dword_8D3E90 and pre-fetch the first entry string v3 = *(const CHAR**)dword_8D3E90.
When the first table dword is null the table is empty; return the negated index of the terminator slot, which is 0.
Walk the table one dword at a time until a match is found or a null terminator entry is reached.
Compare lpString1 against the current entry string v3 for the first cchCount1 characters with MbsnbicollCRTStringCollation; a zero return means a case-insensitive match.
On a collation match, read the byte at offset cchCount1 of the matched string; if it is '=' (61) or null the match is complete and the walk stops.
Advance to the next entry: pre-fetch v3 = *((_DWORD*)v2 + 1) and step v2 += 4.
Return the matching entry index (v2 - dword_8D3E90) >> 2 on success, or its negated value when a null terminator entry is reached.

unresolved: The exact layout of the table entry pointed at by dword_8D3E90 (entry plus following dword) is inferred from the indexing pattern and not independently confirmed.
Whether the trailing '=' terminator implies a token=value table format is not provable from this function alone.
